scope: one pinned L1 episode only; no shared-bank motion qualification

record.foot_slip_contact_fraction_semantics: contacting-foot samples whose world-horizontal foot-speed proxy exceeds 0.35 m/s divided by all contacting-foot samples
record.base_height_semantics: vertical root clearance above highest of nine base-scan hits; invalid scan yields zero and safety stop

family_metrics.transition_progress_semantics: reset-relative root progress clipped to entry transition; separate exit-transition and terminal-flat progress arrays use their registered local-x intervals

audited_local_peak_valley_m.semantics: mesh vertex statistics in sampled square windows; not measured foot contacts

spatial_scale_statistics.semantics: seeded geometry bands before requested peak-valley scaling
